svg.title: coverage ndse original
svg.desc: Coverage of Non-Deterministic Software Engineering, original edition. A developer and an AI assistant work together within six connected areas: context engineering; patterns and quality; tools and workflows; team collaboration; security and governance; and measurement and adoption. Human judgment and ownership remain central.
svg.text: ORIGINAL EDITION / COLLABORATE WITH AN ASSISTANT
Everyday development practices, with human judgment at the centre.
Original focus: collaborate with AI while preserving quality, security and control.
